children: Harte Hanks confirmed expiration of the go‑shop period, received acquisition proposals and reaffirmed its board recommendation of the Star merger.
Go‑shop period under the August 14 Star merger agreement expired on Sept 15, 2026 after solicitation efforts.
Harte Hanks received Acquisition Proposals during the go‑shop and entered confidentiality agreements with some parties.
On Sept 11, 2026 the company designated Exempted Parties to Star and has not found any Superior Proposal.
Stockholders may elect $5.00 cash or 0.50 share of Star’s 10% Series A preferred per Harte Hanks share; cash cap $19.2M.
Termination to accept a Superior Proposal after go‑shop would require a $1,152,000 break fee to Star; board reaffirms recommendation.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Harte Hanks board reaffirms merger with Star after go‑shop ends; received acquisition proposals
